visual_anatomy.title: A large two-line conditional claim introduces the board; two key noun phrases sit in lavender rough-lettered capsules.
visual_anatomy.layout: Two mirrored vertical funnels compare alternative content mixes from top to bottom, with dotted horizontal connectors aligning equivalent stages across the two sides.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Conditional title and short explanation → left/right scenario headers → corresponding funnel stages top to bottom → cross-scenario dotted connectors.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large light sans headline with rough display emphasis, bold scenario labels, italicised funnel-stage abbreviations, and compact bullet lists.
visual_anatomy.colour: Pink identifies the left scenario and aqua the right; pale vertical gradients support the funnels while black/dark text and dotted rules retain contrast.
visual_anatomy.surface: White background, thin dark rounded border around the title field, lightly shaded conical funnel forms, outlined oval stage caps, and restrained shadows.
visual_anatomy.modules: Two parallel three-stage funnels, each with a stage token, a content role, and compact outcome bullets; dotted connectors make the comparison explicit.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Compare how two scenarios change the mix or sequencing of actions across the same stages.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Hold stage definitions constant across two parallel routes, then use aligned connectors to show exactly where scenario-specific content or action differs.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when the scenarios are ethically framed, their stages are genuinely comparable, and each funnel expresses a real progression rather than decorative narrowing.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the source’s appearance-based premise, wording, scenario labels, content recommendations, funnel shapes, dotted connectors, pink/aqua pairing, or title tag treatment.

claim_boundary.note: The asset makes behavioural and outcome assertions about content choices. The corpus does not independently verify those claims or the asserted caption association.
